title: LLM-Archive: a long-running stability archive for commercial language models
description: A public, append-only measurement archive tracking whether a commercial language model's decisions change under equivalent rewordings of the same question, checked monthly against a frozen 15-scenario panel per protocol, with a daily self-check against an independent, frozen, open-weights reference model. Publishes the noise floor, entropy series, and a worst-case loss bound alongside every measurement. Published under three licenses by content type: code AGPL-3.0-only, data CC-BY-4.0, prose CC-BY-SA-4.0 -- this record's single license field below names the code license, since that is what the archived GitHub snapshot primarily is; see CITATION.cff and LICENSE.md in the archived files for the other two.
